LanguageData.CS_Settings_AshfallEnabled_Tooltip: Whether the Ashmounts blanket the land during the Final Empire. When disabled, no ash falls and none settles.
LanguageData.CS_Settings_MistsEnabled_Tooltip: Whether the mists rise at night. When disabled, the mists will not appear.
LanguageData.CS_Settings_MistsLetter_Tooltip: Whether a letter arrives each time the mists settle. The mists behave the same either way - this only controls the notification, which becomes repetitive once they are a nightly fact of life.
LanguageData.CS_Settings_MistsFrequency_Tooltip: How often will the mists come at night
LanguageData.CS_Settings_PawnsKeepVialOnDown_Tooltip: Should pawns drop all their vials when they get downed? Note they will still drop them when they die, regardless of this setting.
LanguageData.CS_Settings_PawnsKeepMetalmindsOnDown_To: Should pawns drop all their metalminds when they get downed? Note they will still drop them when they die, regardless of this setting.
LanguageData.CS_Settings_AlwaysShowAuras_Tooltip: When enabled, iron, steel, and bronze sight lines draw for every burning allomancer, not just the one selected. Can clutter the view in large colonies.
LanguageData.CS_Settings_KolossGrowthYears_Label: Years before a koloss outgrows its skin
LanguageData.CS_Settings_KolossGrowthYears_Tooltip: A koloss never stops growing, and the growing is what kills it. This is how long one lives between the fourth spike going in and its skin failing for good.\n\nEight years fits the arc inside a long colony. Twenty is closer to the books, but most games end before a koloss finishes growing.
